An Attio expert is a consultant or agency that designs, migrates and automates Attio workspaces for you: the data model, the import from HubSpot or Salesforce, the integrations and the reporting. Attio is fast to start on, but a CRM is only as useful as its objects, its data hygiene and what feeds it. Teams that skip the design work end up with a clean-looking workspace nobody trusts.

This guide compares 9 Attio agencies and experts in 2026, using Attio's own Experts directory, each firm's website and published pricing, all checked on 2026-10-21. You get a comparison table, review counts, entry prices where firms publish them, and a framework to pick one.

Disclosure: ManasFlow wrote this guide and ranks itself first. The reason is scope: we set up Attio and build the automation around it (enrichment, outbound, n8n jobs, AI agents) in one team, and we run Attio as our own CRM. ManasFlow is not listed in Attio's Experts directory. If you want a directory-listed firm, a VC-specific build or the cheapest fixed sprint, one of the other entries below will fit better, and we say which.
Best Attio agencies: a brief overview
ManasFlow: Best overall Attio agency for automation-first teams: Attio setup plus the enrichment, outbound and AI workflows that feed it, built by one team.
novlini: Best for Attio plus an outbound stack: the most-reviewed firm in Attio's directory, with Clay and lemlist work alongside the CRM.
Neon Deer Data Labs: Best for data-heavy builds: warehouse pipelines, complex migrations and its own dedupe tooling for Attio.
Sideways CRM: Best for investment and advisory firms: fixed published pricing and a focus on VC, advisory and brokerage teams.
dialed technologies: Best for custom code: native Attio SDK apps, product-usage syncs and API work.
5050Growth: Best for AI deal-flow agents: fixed one-week sprints for VC, PE and startup teams.
Crawl Walk Run: Best for APAC teams leaving HubSpot or Salesforce, with fixed-price phases.
Revautex: Best for workshop-first projects: a 90-minute process workshop before any build.
Craftt: Best for a fast fixed-price start: a published 7-day sprint at $2,500.
Reviews on Attio's Experts directory
Source: attio.com/experts profile pages, checked 2026-10-21. Every listed firm showed a 5.0 rating, so review count is the more useful signal. ManasFlow is not listed in the directory.
Quick takeaways
novlini and Neon Deer Data Labs are the two firms carrying Attio's Elite label, with 68 and 48 directory reviews.
Craftt and Sideways CRM are the only firms here that publish prices: a $2,500 seven-day sprint and setup from £3,500.
Attio's directory uses three labels, Elite, Advanced and Core, and every firm we checked showed a 5.0 rating, so the tier and the number of reviews tell you more than the stars.

1. ManasFlow, best overall Attio agency for automation-first teams

ManasFlow is an AI automation agency that builds go-to-market systems, and Attio is the CRM we run our own pipeline on. That matters for one reason: we have lived with the same objects, lists and API limits you will. Our Attio agency service covers the workspace itself (objects, attributes, lists, views, permissions), the migration from HubSpot, Pipedrive or spreadsheets, and then the part most CRM projects leave out: the systems that keep Attio full of accurate data.

That second half is where we spend most of our time. We build enrichment that writes verified company and contact data into Attio, outbound sequences in Instantly and HeyReach that log replies back to the right record, and scheduled n8n jobs that dedupe records, flag stalled deals and post a weekly digest to Slack. The CRM hygiene automation workflow shows the pattern step by step.
Key features
Attio data model design, migration and permissions, scoped before any import
Enrichment and scoring pipelines that write into Attio with validation and logging
Outbound wiring: Instantly and HeyReach replies logged to the right Attio record
n8n jobs for dedupe, stalled-deal alerts and lead routing (custom n8n automation)
AI agents for research and record updates, with every write checked before it lands
Option to place an embedded GTM engineer through hire a GTM engineer
Best for
B2B SaaS and agency teams that want Attio plus the outbound and enrichment that feed it
Teams moving off HubSpot or Pipedrive who also want the old automations rebuilt properly
Founders who want one team for the CRM and the GTM plumbing around it
Pricing
Custom quote after a discovery call
Embedded GTM engineer placement from $60,000 a year, with a 90-day replacement guarantee
Pros
One team covers Attio, enrichment, outbound and n8n automation, so nothing gets lost between vendors
We run Attio, Instantly, HeyReach, Unipile and n8n for our own pipeline, so the advice comes from daily use
Delivery in English, French and Arabic
Cons
Not listed in Attio's Experts directory. If a directory badge is a buying requirement, pick novlini, Neon Deer or another listed firm
No published fixed-price package. Craftt or Sideways CRM are easier to budget for a simple setup
If you want to see how we scope it, start with the Attio agency page and book a call from there.
2. novlini, best for Attio plus an outbound stack

novlini is a GTM and CRM consultancy based in Paris with an Elite label and 68 reviews in Attio's directory, the most of any firm we checked. Its site describes a six-phase process (discovery, audit and mapping, roadmap, build, enablement, ongoing partnership) and lists 22 people across GTM engineering, CRM architecture and automation.

The firm's Attio work sits next to outbound tooling: its site names Clay, lemlist and Customer.io, and it runs HubSpot to Attio migrations. That makes it a good match for teams that want the CRM and the prospecting stack designed together.
Key features
Elite label in Attio's Experts directory
CRM migrations, notably from HubSpot
GTM systems with Clay, lemlist and Customer.io
Structured six-phase delivery with enablement
Best for
Scale-ups that want Attio and outbound designed by one firm
French and English speaking teams
Pricing
Custom quote after a free discovery call
Pros
Largest review base in Attio's directory
Team large enough to run several workstreams at once
Cons
No public pricing
Some counters on its site render as "0+", so its own stats are hard to verify there
3. Neon Deer Data Labs, best for data-heavy Attio builds

Neon Deer Data Labs is a Seattle data-engineering firm with an Elite label and a "Founding Expert" badge in Attio's directory (48 reviews). It handles Attio implementation, migrations from Affinity, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce, Copper and spreadsheets, and custom pipelines built with dbt, Prefect and dltHub.

It also sells its own subscription platform for Attio with duplicate detection, bulk merge, automations and notifications, priced by workspace size. If your Attio project is really a data project, this is the most engineering-heavy option on the list.
Key features
Migrations from six CRMs plus spreadsheets
Warehouse and pipeline work with dbt, Prefect and dltHub
Own dedupe and bulk-merge platform for Attio
Integrations with Clay, Zapier, Make, n8n, Apollo, HeyReach, Stripe and accounting tools
Best for
Teams syncing Attio with a data warehouse or billing system
Messy multi-source migrations
Pricing
Custom quote; its platform is priced by Attio workspace size
Pros
Real data-engineering depth
Tooling that keeps working after the project ends
Cons
Its process starts with a paid strategy session whose price is not published
More than a small team with a simple pipeline needs
4. Sideways CRM, best for investment and advisory firms

Sideways CRM is a London Attio consultancy led by founder Will Sawney, with an Advanced label and 22 directory reviews. It focuses on investment, advisory and brokerage firms and says it has completed more than 35 setups since 2023.
It is also one of only two firms here that publish prices, which makes budgeting simple.
Key features
Setup and migration from Salesforce, Airtable, HubSpot and Affinity
Audits, with the fee credited against setup
Monthly build and partnership plans
Best for
VC firms, advisory boutiques and brokers
Teams that want a fixed price before they start
Pricing
Audit £500, credited against setup
Setup from £3,500 fixed
Build from £1,600 a month; ongoing partnership from £850 a month
Pros
Published pricing
Deep fit for relationship-driven deal teams
Cons
Founder-centred shop that brings in specialists for complex builds
Vertical focus is a weaker match for SaaS sales teams
5. dialed technologies, best for custom code on Attio

dialed technologies is a developer-founded Attio shop in New York with an Advanced label and 20 directory reviews. Its work covers workspace design, migrations, two-way and product-usage syncs, native Attio SDK apps, API integrations and de-duplication.
Engagements start with a two-week sprint, then move to a monthly arrangement. Its directory profile lists Redpoint Ventures and Squadra VC among its clients.
Key features
Native Attio SDK apps
Product-usage and two-way syncs
API integrations and de-duplication
Two-week sprint, then monthly
Best for
Product-led SaaS teams that want usage data inside Attio
Teams whose Attio needs go beyond configuration into custom code
Pricing
Custom quote
Pros
Engineering-first approach to Attio
Clear sprint-then-monthly structure
Cons
Thin public detail on its own site: no pricing and no named tools beyond Attio
6. 5050Growth, best for AI deal-flow agents

5050Growth is a Berlin consultancy led by Nacho Lafuente, with an Advanced label and 17 directory reviews. It works with VC, PE, family offices and startups on data models, migrations, integrations, AI agents and training, sold as fixed-fee one-week sprints with no retainer.
Its tool list is broad for a small practice: Clay, lemlist, HeyReach, n8n, Intercom, Stripe, Granola, Typeform and Claude through MCP.
Key features
One-week fixed-fee sprints
AI agents for deal-flow scoring
Delivery in English, German and Spanish
Best for
Investment firms that want AI scoring on inbound deals
Teams that want short fixed engagements and no retainer
Pricing
Fixed price per phase; amounts not published
Pros
No long contract required
Modern AI tooling in the delivery
Cons
Essentially a one-person practice, so capacity is limited
7. Crawl Walk Run, best for APAC teams

Crawl Walk Run is a Sydney consultancy with an Advanced label and 16 directory reviews. It describes itself as APAC's first Attio Expert Partner and focuses on businesses moving from HubSpot or Salesforce to Attio. Clients named in its directory profile include IAB Australia and River Capital.
Its work covers implementation, migrations, integrations through Zapier, n8n and the API, AI workflows with Claude and ChatGPT, training and support, priced as fixed-price phases.
Key features
HubSpot and Salesforce to Attio migrations
Zapier, n8n and API integrations
Training and ongoing support
Best for
Australian and APAC companies that want a partner in their time zone
Pricing
Fixed-price phases, custom quote
Pros
Time-zone fit for APAC
Clear focus on CRM exits
Cons
Small team, and it lists support for APAC and the Americas only, not EMEA

8. Revautex, best for workshop-first projects

Revautex is a Toronto Attio consultancy led by founder Kayla Campos, with an Advanced label and 15 directory reviews. It covers implementation, automation, integrations and data cleansing and enrichment, using n8n, Zapier and Clay.
Every project starts with a 90-minute strategy workshop, and the firm says a proposal follows within 24 hours. That suits teams that are not yet sure what their Attio setup should look like.

Data cleansing and enrichment
n8n, Zapier and Clay integrations
English and Portuguese delivery
Best for
